name: Button
description: A button is used to trigger an action, such as submitting, saving, confirming, cancelling, or starting a task.

attributes.name: leadingIcon
attributes.description: Icon shown before the button text.

attributes.name: trailingIcon
attributes.description: Icon shown after the button text.

attributes.name: flavor
attributes.description: Determines the visual style of the button.
attributes.type: primary | positive | negative | outline | outline-subtle | text | subtle

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: Controls whether the button is sharp, rounded, or fully rounded.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Controls the size of the button.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the button and applies disabled styling.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The button type when used inside a form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name for the button when used in a form.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted with the button's name when used in a form.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Content shown inside the button, usually text.

name: Dialog
description: A dialog is a reusable modal or non-modal window used to get the user's attention, present important information, or ask the user to make a decision.
useCases: asking the user to make an important decision
example:
<zeta-dialog id="dialog1" flavor="default">
  Dialog content goes here.
  <zeta-icon slot="icon" rounded></zeta-icon>
  <zeta-button slot="confirm" size="medium" shape="sharp" flavor="primary">Confirm</zeta-button>
  <zeta-button slot="cancel" size="medium" shape="sharp" flavor="outline-subtle">Cancel</zeta-button>
  <zeta-button slot="other" size="medium" shape="sharp" flavor="text">Other</zeta-button>
</zeta-dialog>

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title of the dialog.

attributes.name: centered
attributes.description: Whether the dialog content/header is centered.

attributes.name: initialOpen
attributes.description: Whether the dialog is initially open.

attributes.name: showLeadingIcon
attributes.description: Whether to show a leading icon in the dialog header.

attributes.name: leadingIcon
attributes.description: Icon to display in the dialog header.

attributes.name: flavor
attributes.description: The type of dialog. Changes the icon and icon colour shown in the header.

attributes.name: confirmButtonFlavor
attributes.description: Colour style of the confirm button.

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Whether the component uses rounded or sharp styling.

attributes.name: returnValue
attributes.description: Return value of the dialog.

attributes.name: closeOnBarrierClicked
attributes.description: Whether the modal should close when the background barrier is clicked.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the dialog is open or closed.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Body content of the dialog, usually text.

slots.name: confirm
slots.description: Button used in the footer for the main confirm action.

slots.name: cancel
slots.description: Button used in the footer for the cancel action.

name: Dropdown Menu
description: A dropdown menu allows users to select an option from a list that appears when the menu is clicked or tapped.
useCases: selecting one option from a list
saving space when showing all options would clutter the UI
example:
<zeta-dropdown-menu-button name="dropdown-menu" rounded size="small" flavor="primary">
  <zeta-dropdown-menu-item rounded size="medium">Option 1</zeta-dropdown-menu-item>
  <zeta-dropdown-menu-item rounded size="medium">Option 2</zeta-dropdown-menu-item>
  <zeta-dropdown-menu-item rounded size="medium">Option 3</zeta-dropdown-menu-item>
</zeta-dropdown-menu-button>

attributes.name: matchParentWidth
attributes.description: Whether the dropdown menu should match the width of its parent.

attributes.name: buttonTextMatchesSelected
attributes.description: Whether the button text should update to match the selected item. Only applies to the text-dropdown type.

attributes.name: defaultText
attributes.description: The default text to display when no item is selected.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controls whether the dropdown menu is open.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of dropdown menu.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: The direction of the droppable relative to the anchor.

attributes.name: flavor
attributes.description: The flavor of the dropdown button.
attributes.type: primary | positive | negative | outline | outline-subtle | text | subtle

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Whether the component uses rounded or sharp styling.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The size of the component.

name: Avatar
description: An avatar is a visual representation of a user or entity.

attributes.name: show-ring
attributes.description: Shows the ring around the avatar.

attributes.name: show-close
attributes.description: Shows the close icon.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The size of the avatar.
attributes.type: xxxs | xxs | xs | s | m | l | xl | xxl | xxxl | undefined

slots.name: default
slots.description: The content of the avatar. Should be an img element, a zeta-icon, or text.

slots.name: status
slots.description: The content of the status slot. Usually used for indicators or badges.

name: Checkbox
description: Checkboxes allow users to select one or more items from a set, or turn an option on or off.
useCases: turning a setting on or off
choosing multiple items from a list
example:
<zeta-checkbox name="terms" value="accepted">
  I agree to the terms
</zeta-checkbox>

attributes.name: reverse
attributes.description: Whether the order of the checkbox and its label should be reversed.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the form control.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the form control is required before submitting the form.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value submitted when the checkbox is part of a form.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: The checked state of the checkbox.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: A mixed or unknown checkbox state.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the checkbox and applies disabled styles.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size of the component.

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Whether the component is rounded or sharp.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The label/content shown next to the checkbox.

name: Assist Chip
description: Assist chips are compact chips that can be clickable, selectable, and draggable.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Icon shown in the chip.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the chip and applies disabled styles.

attributes.name: tabIndex
attributes.description: The tab index used to determine focus order.

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Whether the component is rounded or sharp.

name: Empty State
description: Empty states are used to communicate that no data is available for display, such as no results, first use, no data, or user-cleared states.
useCases: showing an empty list or table
example:
<zeta-empty-state title="No results found" description="Try adjusting your filters.">
  <zeta-button slot="primaryAction" flavor="primary">Clear filters</zeta-button>
  <zeta-button slot="secondaryAction" flavor="outline-subtle">Go back</zeta-button>
</zeta-empty-state>

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title of the empty state.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description of the empty state.

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Whether the component is rounded or sharp.

slots.name: primaryAction
slots.description: Primary action button. Should be a zeta-button.

slots.name: secondaryAction
slots.description: Secondary action button. Should be a zeta-button.

slots.name: illustration
slots.description: Illustration to display in the empty state. Should be a zeta-illustration.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Title of the empty state. Should be an h4 element.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Description of the empty state. Should be a p element.

name: Global Header
description: The global header is the topmost persistent navigation bar across an application. It can contain branding, primary navigation, search, user profile access, and global actions.
example: Device Manager

attributes.name: data-theme
attributes.description: Autosets the theme to dark mode for this component.

attributes.name: platformName
attributes.description: The platform name text on the header.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name to show in the header, next to the user icon.

attributes.name: initials
attributes.description: The initials to display within the user icon.

attributes.name: appSwitcher
attributes.description: Shows the app switcher icon.

attributes.name: searchbar
attributes.description: Shows the search bar.

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Whether the component is rounded or sharp.

slots.name: platform-name
slots.description: Slot for the platform name in the header. Falls back to the platformName property if not provided.

slots.name: menu-items
slots.description: Slot for menu items on the left side of the header. Expects zeta-button or zeta-dropdown-menu-button elements.

slots.name: action-items
slots.description: Slot for action items on the right side of the header. Expects zeta-icon-button or zeta-action-menu-button elements.

slots.name: user-avatar
slots.description: Slot for user avatar. Input should be zeta-avatar with size set to xxs.

slots.name: logo
slots.description: Slot for a custom logo to replace the default Zebra logo.

name: Progress Bar
description: Progress bars express an unspecified wait time or display the length of a process.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The size of the progress indicator. Can be medium or thin.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Displays the indeterminate progress indicator. If true, value is ignored.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The percent complete. Use a floating point number between 0.0 and 1.0, unless maxValue is set.

attributes.name: maxValue
attributes.description: If maxValue is null, value is treated as a percentage. Otherwise value can be any number between 0 and maxValue.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The label for the progress indicator.

attributes.name: buffering
attributes.description: Displays buffering dots at the end of the progress indicator. Pauses animation if indeterminate is true.

attributes.name: rounded
attributes.description: Whether the component is rounded or sharp.
